_comment: Shared scoring contract. The extension fallback (extension/src/utils/risk-score.ts) and the backend (backend/app/services/scoring_service.py) reimplement the same URL/DOM scoring in two languages. These vectors are loaded by BOTH extension/src/utils/scoring-contract.test.ts and backend/tests/test_scoring_contract.py, which assert each side produces the url_score, dom_score, and reason lists below, plus heuristic_score: URL + DOM points scaled onto 0-100, which is the extension's local risk score and the base the backend adds threat intel, TLS, domain age, and ML on top of. label is that score's label. A weight or reason changed on only one side breaks that side's run. Edit this file and both implementations together.

vectors.name: no https plus two keywords
url_reasons: Domain or path contains suspicious keywords
vectors.label: safe

vectors.name: full-script homograph
url_reasons: Domain uses look-alike Unicode characters resembling apple.com (homograph attack)
vectors.label: safe

vectors.name: mixed-script homograph
url_reasons: Domain uses look-alike Unicode characters resembling google.com (homograph attack)
Domain label mixes multiple writing scripts (possible homograph attack)
vectors.label: suspicious

vectors.name: brand domain hidden in subdomains
url_reasons: A subdomain embeds paypal.com, but the real registered domain is different (possible impersonation)
vectors.label: safe

vectors.name: dom credential context
dom_reasons: Form submits data to an external domain
vectors.label: safe

vectors.name: brand mention without credential surface is not flagged
dom_reasons: Page has a high ratio of external links
vectors.label: safe

vectors.name: brand impersonation in a credential context
dom_reasons: Page text references a well-known brand that does not match this domain
Page favicon is hotlinked from a different brand's domain
vectors.label: suspicious

vectors.name: hidden inputs alone are not flagged
vectors.label: safe

vectors.name: cloned brand login on a look-alike domain
url_reasons: Domain or path contains suspicious keywords
dom_reasons: Form submits data to an external domain
Page text references a well-known brand that does not match this domain
vectors.label: dangerous

vectors.name: leading www is not a subdomain
vectors.label: safe
